key_idea: The pencils point different ways, so compare them from tip to end, not by where they sit.
steps: Look at each pencil from its pointy tip to its flat end.
Pencils A, C and E are the shorter ones. Pencil D is longer than them.
Pencil B is even longer than D. It is the longest pencil.

choice_feedback.A: Pencil A is short. Pencil B is much longer.
choice_feedback.C: Pencil C is the shortest pencil of all.
choice_feedback.D: Pencil D is long, but pencil B is longer.
choice_feedback.E: Pencil E is shorter than both B and D.
